Always structure your Ansible content into roles and collections. Each role or module must focus on a single, well-defined task. Avoid monolithic roles. Create dedicated `_info` or `_facts` modules/tasks for gathering information.

Enforce strict YAML formatting. All YAML files must begin with `---`. Use two spaces for indentation, never tabs. Quote strings only when necessary; prefer single quotes. Use double quotes for escaping characters or multi-line strings. Use exactly one space after a colon in key-value pairs. Always use the structured map style for module parameters, not the legacy `key=value` style. Standardize on `true`/`false`. Adopt consistent `snake_case` naming. Prefix role names with the collection namespace to prevent collisions.
